results.title: Privacy Manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) not found
results.description: Apple requires a Privacy Manifest for all apps since May 2024. Without it, the app will be rejected. In Expo Managed, configure via expo.ios.privacyManifests in app.json.
results.fix: Add privacyManifests under expo.ios in app.json with the APIs used and their reasons.

results.title: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults not declared in the Privacy Manifest
results.description: The module using this API was detected but it is not declared in the Privacy Manifest. Apple will reject the app.
results.fix: Add NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults with reason C617.1 under expo.ios.privacyManifests.NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes in app.json.
